---
name: Something still looks light or unreadable
about: Report a DSM screen the dark theme doesn't cover well
labels: theme
---

**Where in DSM:** (app and screen, e.g. Control Panel > Login Portal)

**DSM version:** (Control Panel > Info Center)

**Screenshot:**

**Stylesheets:** open the Dark Mode app in DSM's main menu, click "Download your NAS's stylesheets" and attach `dsm-styles.tgz`. It lets the problem be fixed against your exact DSM version.

**Last setup run:** paste the "Last setup run" text from the Dark Mode app.
